dimensions.issue_validity: Valid, well-documented bug filed by the repository owner. The task_injection workaround breaks @prompt expansion by prepending text before the @line-cook command.
dimensions.actionability: Highly actionable. The exact file and line are identified (config.py line 77), root cause explained (workaround for now-fixed Kiro bug #4141), and concrete fix proposed (remove task_injection from kiro profile). PR #15 was created but appears not yet merged.
dimensions.project_relevance: Directly relevant. The task_injection key exists in core/line_loop/config.py and consumption logic in phase.py.
dimensions.priority_signal: High priority. This bug causes the cook phase to completely fail for all Kiro CLI users, leading to repeated premature_completion outcomes.
dimensions.duplicate_check: No duplicate found among open issues.

rationale: Verified, high-impact bug. The task_injection workaround at config.py line 77, originally for Kiro bug #4141, now actively breaks @prompt expansion in kiro-cli v1.26.2. The fix has not yet been applied to main despite PR #15 being referenced. The issue is well-documented with root cause analysis and concrete fix.
